digest.component_or_area: provider parity eval corpus and scoring
propositions: The code-review-verify spec emits verifications with no decision polarity (no FAIL/BLOCK verdict), causing _verdict_decision to always map its output to advisory regardless of gold label

Treating a non-empty verifications list as block would fix the recall miss for V-real-defect but create a false accept by mis-scoring V-clean-rename as block, since both cases are required to emit non-empty verification lists
code-review-verify must be excluded from the parity corpus by a separate, named mechanism distinct from AGENTIC_SOLVERS to prevent future collapsing that would re-admit mis-scored cases

Excluding the two verify cases reduces n_gold from 28 to 26 (still above MIN_GOLD_ITEMS threshold of 20) and fixes a symmetric recall miss on both standard and frontier arms without changing gating verdicts
